description: Land Title Settlement Department - Ginipendegama, Wariyapola D/S Division, Kurunegala District - Cad. Map No. 420911 (24/0475)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of title determinations for specific land parcels, including detailed information about parcel numbers, extent, owners' names and addresses, title classifications, and encumbrances. The content is focused entirely on land ownership and property rights, falling squarely within the Land Gazette category (Type 4) which covers land registrations, property ownership, and land title matters.
